messages:
Samir: kicking off POC with VertexHealth — want to lock scope, success criteria, timeline, and SE coverage. proposing 4-week POC. primary workload: clinical note summarization + clinician triage prompts. asking SEs: who can own integration + evals?
Elena: I can take lead on integration and eval harness. need sample data (de-identified) and a small prompt set (10-20) to seed quality checks.
Margo: Sales ask — pricing for a 4-week proof (reserved SE hours + hosted usage). can we price as 160 SE hours + usage estimate? will follow up with numbers if you confirm hours.
Kevin: quick Q on success criteria — does Vertex want automated ROUGE-like metrics or human clinical ratings? that changes how we run evals.
Samir: they want both: automated for fast iter, and clinician scoring for final acceptance. success = 80% clinician accept rate on summaries + latency < 400ms p95 for 512-token responses. cost target: <$0.02/token equivalent.
Elena: noted. i'll build two eval buckets: 1) automated (ROUGE/BLEU + embedding similarity) 2) human panel (10 clinicians, blinded). need contact to recruit clinicians or we run with Vertex reviewers?
Margo: Vertex will provide 5 reviewers; we can supplement with our clinical partners if needed. Margo: i'll confirm reviewer contact by Thurs. :thumbsup:
Kevin: SE questions: 1) will this run on Hosted API or Dedicated? 2) any PHI in data? impacts privacy and KMS requirements.
Samir: plan is hosted API first, demo on dedicated if they require isolation. data will be de-identified but legal wants full questionnaire answered as precaution.
Legal_Bot: security questionnaire upload: https://redwood.internal/q-upload/vertexhealth-vhcq-2026 — status: pending review (security).
Elena: blocker: if legal flags KMS/HSM or on-prem requirement then timeline shifts. for hosted -> dedicated conversion we need 2-3 weeks more for infra + capacity allocation.
Margo: noted — i'll flag potential procurement constraint on Vertex side.
Samir: proposed milestone plan: 
```
Week 0 (pre-POC): NDA + questionnaire in flight, dataset delivery mockups
Week 1: integration + sample prompts, baseline run, streaming config test
Week 2: automated evals + iterate prompts, perf tuning (batching/kv cache)
Week 3: human evals + quality fixes, security checklist complete
Week 4: final demo, handoff runbook, pricing/recommendation doc
```
Elena: deliverables I'll own: integration repo + sample app, eval harness + scripts, perf report (latency/cost), rollout runbook.
Kevin: SE staffing: i can allocate 40h/week for week1-2, 20h/week week3, backup by Elena for week4. need product engineer for sample app (can we get 8 hours from eng-platform?).
Samir: I'll request eng-platform support; Margo please confirm SE hour commit to the customer so we can bill/discount accordingly.
Margo: will confirm hours and send a formal SOW draft by Friday.
Elena: small tech note — please provide sample of longest expected input (max tokens) and expected avg tokens in responses. helps choose model variant + quantization.
Samir: Vertex will share sample payloads by Wed EOD.
Kevin: action items:
- Elena: integration + eval harness (owner)
- Kevin: perf tuning + sample app (owner)
- Margo: SOW + reviewer contacts + pricing
- Samir: coordinate legal/questionnaire + get dataset from Vertex
Deadlines: initial integration demo by 1845123060 (Wed), automated evals ready by 1845123130 (next Monday).
Margo: any known enterprise blockers? my list: procurement lead time, SOC2/KMS, legal review on data sharing.
Elena: also model-card approval for clinical use and inferencing latency SLO.
Samir: good call. i'll add those to the risk register and escalate if legal flags KMS requirement.
Kevin: if dedicated flow is required, tell Vertex to expect +2 weeks and an uplift on price for reserved capacity.
Margo: i'll prep both hosted and dedicated pricing options.
Samir: thanks team —keeping this thread for coordination. ping here for blockers. :rocket:
